body:
📦 **Blockside `c898bd4`** — Add 26-connected Minimax zero-floating build order to townRise

Refs TASK-1350

- 63_townrise.js:
  - Add townRiseConnect (255-bucket FIFO Dial Minimax propagation seeded
    from ground z <= minZ + 2, water deck wz..wz+2, and grounded column
    bottoms; radius 2..6 bridge for small gaps; >= 248 fallback for remote
    ungrounded details) and wire into townRiseLoad in topological popSeq
    order, preserving all AUTO / manual build0..build1 stages and zero
    re-baking requirement for existing townkit assets.
  - Interpolate townRiseCount smoothly along connected ord and expose
    townRiseFloatCheck diagnostics via __game.townRise('floatCheck') in
    90_main.js.
- Rebuild index.html (5.57 MB, core cd35e6b10a4ab2ae).

👥 參與者：@ridge-001

---
